What a bite does

Paralysis and coagulopathy can develop within hours untreated.

Antivenom source. Australia.

Name and taxonomy. Broad et al. (1979) SC saline: N. s. scutatus 0.118; N. s. occidentalis 0.194; N. ater niger 0.131; N. ater serventyi 0.338 (a 2.9x spread).

If you are bitten

Get to a hospital that holds antivenom. Keep still, remove rings and watches, and do not cut, suck or tie off the bite. Use the red “Bitten?” button at the top of any page.
